title: 第二十三章 姑娘钱能折现吗求追读第二十四章 还得感激他求追读
lines: 青田镇大雾山。
一道身影在雾气中穿梭，偶尔停下来搜寻一番。
这道身影正是林砚，他的身后背着竹筐，已经装了不少药材，全是他此次进山的收获。
“十年份的人参三根，五年份的还阳草四株，这一趟收获下来，也是超过二十两银子了。”
清点着竹筐里的收获，林砚眸子看向前方浓雾处，他现在已经是靠近大雾山最核心区域了。
大雾山毒瘴越往里越浓，毒性也就越强。
他不敢再往前了！
“地脉真解确实好用。”
林砚心中感慨，这已经不是他第一次进山了，而是这个月的第三次。
大雾山雾浓，视线受阻，他完全是凭着地脉真解里面学的观察地气的本领，查看脚下地形和草木生长状况来寻找的药草。
“凭着这些药材，三天内我应当能够二次磨皮了，接下来便是安心修炼，一举冲破关卡达到二次磨皮。”
等到二次磨皮之后，再深入大雾山。
下山返回到自己院子，林砚将竹筐放下，把药材清洗干净后煎服。
药汤入喉，林砚不敢耽搁，站在院中开始修炼。
脑海中，武道树已经达到一尺九寸多些。
离着两尺快了！
林砚深吸一口气，起身站桩，开始今日的修炼。
两日后。
夜。
淡淡的月光洒落在院中。
林砚赤裸上身，站在院子中央。
今日他涂抹的壮肌膏的用量，是往日的三倍。
体内气血如沸水般翻涌，皮下的肉也是隐隐发胀，仿佛有无数只蚂蚁在爬行。
林砚抬手，劈山拳挥出。
一遍，两遍，三遍……
脑海中的武道树缓缓拔高，当达到两尺的那一刻，瞬间震荡摇曳！
与此同时，林砚体内那股翻涌的气血，仿佛找到了宣泄口，猛地向周身血肉冲去。
短短几息时间，林砚身躯便是急速膨胀，宛若充气气球。
也不知道过去了多久……
轰！
林砚耳边似乎响起一声闷雷。
随后，一切归于平静。
林砚睁开眼。
月光还是那片月光，院子还是那个院子，但一切在他眼中，都变得不一样了。
他能清楚地看见三丈外墙根下那几株野草的轻微晃动，能感受到夜风拂过皮肤时，每一丝气流的方向。
林砚低头看向自己的手，皮肤比以前更紧致了些，但并不是那种粗糙的厚茧，反而像一层柔韧的薄革，指尖轻轻一按，能感觉到皮下那股蓬勃的力量。
啪！
content_en:
Qingtian Town Smoky Mountains.
A figure shuttled through the mist, occasionally stopping to search.
This figure is none other than Lin Yan. He is carrying a bamboo basket behind his back, which has already contained a lot of medicinal materials, all of which were harvested from his trip to the mountains.
"Three ten-year-old ginseng and four five-year-old Huanyang grass. The harvest from this trip is more than twenty taels of silver."
Counting the harvest in the bamboo basket, Lin Yan looked towards the thick fog ahead. He was now close to the core area of the Great Smoky Mountains.
The poisonous miasma in the Great Smoky Mountains becomes thicker and more toxic the deeper you go.
He dare not go any further!
"The true solution to earth veins is really useful."
Lin Yan sighed in his heart, this was not the first time he went into the mountains, but the third time this month.
The fog in the Smoky Mountains obstructed his line of sight. He relied solely on the ability to observe the earth's atmosphere that he had learned in the Earth Veins True Solution, and looked for herbs by checking the terrain under his feet and the growth of vegetation.
"With these medicinal materials, I should be able to achieve the second microdermabrasion within three days. The next step is to practice with peace of mind and break through the barrier to achieve the second microdermabrasion in one fell swoop."
Wait until after the second skin resurfacing, then go deep into the Smoky Mountains.
After going down the mountain and returning to his yard, Lin Yan put down the bamboo basket, cleaned the medicinal materials and decocted them.
The medicinal soup entered his throat, Lin Yan did not dare to delay, and stood in the courtyard and began to practice.
In his mind, the martial arts tree has reached over one foot nine inches.
It's almost two feet away!
Lin Yan took a deep breath, stood up, and started today's practice.
——
Two days later.
night.
The faint moonlight fell on the courtyard.
Lin Yan stood naked in the middle of the yard.
The amount of muscle-strengthening ointment he applied today was three times the usual amount.
The qi and blood in the body surged like boiling water, and the flesh under the skin was also faintly swollen, as if countless ants were crawling.
Lin Yan raised his hand and swung the Mountain Splitting Fist.
Once, twice, three times...
The martial arts tree in my mind slowly rose up, and when it reached two feet, it shook and swayed instantly!
At the same time, the surging Qi and blood in Lin Yan's body seemed to have found an outlet and rushed towards the flesh and blood around him.
In just a few breaths, Lin Yan's body expanded rapidly, like an inflated balloon.
I don’t know how much time has passed...
Boom!
A muffled thunder seemed to ring in Lin Yan's ears.
Then everything calmed down.
Lin Yan opened his eyes.
The moonlight was still the same moonlight, and the yard was still the same yard, but everything was different in his eyes.
He could clearly see the slight swaying of a few wild grasses under the three-foot-long outer wall, and could feel the direction of every airflow as the night wind blew over his skin.
Lin Yan lowered his head and looked at his hands. The skin was tighter than before, but it was not a rough, thick callus. Instead, it was like a layer of flexible thin leather. With a gentle press of his fingertips, he could feel the vigorous power under the skin.
Snap!
